essence: World as net or picture-whirl: seeing all, joy upsurges.
Neither pain nor joy cast: the middle is knowable.
Everywhere-I-am-thus: gaze seeing none else, happy.
Grasped-grasping common: yogin's care in relation.
Self in other's body: own-body-regard dissolved, pervasive.
Supportless mind: thoughts not thought, Bhairava in self.
All-knowing, all-doing: he indeed I — Śiva from firmness.
World-plays as waves and flames: Bhairava's manifest only.

rasa.justification: Passions placed in range rather than fought, poles refused, happiness carried as common — each verse subtracts a preference; the last folds all manifestation into wave-and-flame: everything is display already.

sections.SUMMARY: The neutrality-block: within the whole passion-range reality stays uncaused; the world seen as net or picture-whirl makes seeing-all itself joy; neither pain nor joy receives the cast mind — the middle remains knowable; everywhere-I-am-thus with single gaze makes happy; pot and skin-wall contemplations turning all-pervading into all-going; the yogin's distinction as attentive relation to common awareness; self perceived in other's bodies dissolving own-body-regard; supportless mind cancelling thought until Bhairava stands in self; and the lord lit by all knowing, being, pervading — 'he indeed I' from firmness — with all world-plays nothing but waves and flames.
sections.FUNCTION: Neutralizes preference and self-stake — from passions to relations to identity to display.
sections.KEY TERMS: ṣaḍ-viṣaya (six-passion range); samāna-saṃvid (common awareness); svātmaniṣṭhā (yogin's distinction as care); bhairavatva-as-avatāra (world-plays as manifestations).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Identity (v109) is the pivot between the āṇava cluster and the fruit-sealing verses to come.
sections.BOUNDARY: Carefulness (sāvadhānatā) named but not described — one word, left open.
sections.EXPLANATION: The song works by placement rather than renunciation: the six passions are not fought but ranged, the world held as spectacle so that seeing-all is joy, and even pain and joy refused their usual seats so the middle shows. Self-contemplation expands from body to everywhere (pot and skin-walls dissolving), relation becomes the yogin's only distinction — care rather than attainment — other-bodies receive one's own self, and supportless mind cancels volition until 'he indeed I' is a statement made from firmness rather than belief. Wave-and-flame close the list: nothing outside is real, everything only manifest.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh's intensity/access theme as inverse here (this is equanimity-mode); cf. sutasutra citta as mantra — mind-language shared across the canon.
